headline: Powder Room Renovation Mistakes Homeowners Make in Tight Spaces
articleBody:
Because powder rooms are compact, even tiny layout or material mistakes quickly become daily annoyances. Watch out for these frequent oversights before you begin.

Common Mistakes to Avoid:
1. Buying fixtures before measuring clearances: Selecting an oversized vanity or extended-bowl toilet can crowd the room and block standard door clearance. Always confirm rough-in dimensions first.
2. Ignoring door swings: Forgetting to account for how an inward-swinging door interacts with the front edge of a sink makes entering and exiting awkward.
3. Choosing materials that cannot handle moisture: Using untreated wall treatments or easily warped surfaces near hand-washing zones leads to premature wear. Pick wipeable, durable materials.
4. Assuming an open window replaces fan needs: Some local rules mandate mechanical ventilation regardless of a window, specifically requiring exterior ducting and minimum airflow rates.
5. Proceeding without checking permit rules: While simple fixture swaps in original locations are often exempt, moving pipes or adding circuits usually triggers permits and inspections.
